claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.saveOverride
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants a special cast path for an existing spell and changes that granted cast's resolution by auto-succeeding on the spell's saving throw. The current surface can grant the spell and can model save-gate behavior on the spell itself, but it cannot attach a save override to only one grant path.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: With this feature, you can cast the spell without expending a spell slot to contact your patron, and you automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw.
